summary.title: Product Team Weekly Sync
summary.executiveSummary: The meeting covered several operational reminders including a book club, customer interview follow-ups, and an engagement survey. Key updates included new PM hires, handbook language changes regarding internal vs. external feedback, and the launch of customer discovery training videos. The team discussed improvements for the release kickoff format, the introduction of product discovery sprints, and a proactive approach to performance and scalability issues. Finally, updates were provided on release organization and label changes.
keyDiscussionPoints: Reminders for the upcoming book club, customer interview spreadsheet follow-ups, and the monthly engagement survey.
Goal to complete at least three customer interviews per PM before the end of Q2.
Updates to the category maturity page with new charts to help forecast maturity.
Hiring updates: Gabe Weaver hired as a managed PM and Dov Her Skivitz as an APM for monitoring.
Handbook update clarifying that internal feedback (dog-fooding) should not be valued 10x more than external customer feedback, though internal teams should still be treated as early customers.
Upcoming customer discovery training videos from Sarah O'Donnell's team.
Feedback on the release kickoff call: need for more screenshots/mockups, problem-focused talk tracks, and a rethink of the format due to increasing speaker count.
Introduction of product discovery sprints (based on Mark Kunspak's methodology) to be piloted by the source code group.
Discussion on proactive performance and scalability management, specifically regarding GitLab.com outages and resource limits (e.g., Redis, unit tests).
Release team updates on self-organization, dual-track agile approaches, and improving delivery percentages.
Renaming of the 'Promised' label to 'Playing Priority' to better reflect product management responsibilities.
decisions: New hires will be required to read the book 'Inspired' as part of onboarding.
The 'Promised' label is renamed to 'Playing Priority' and should only be applied by responsible product managers.
The source code group will pilot a product discovery sprint for file-by-file navigation in release 12.3.
Performance issues are categorized as bugs but require proactive management and infrastructure/SRE involvement early in the pipeline.
The release kickoff format will be re-evaluated and tweaked before the next month's release.

actionItems.task: Read the book 'Inspired' in preparation for the book club.
Follow up on customer contacts listed in the interview spreadsheet to ensure good will with the CS and Sales teams.
Send the engagement survey link to Fabia and Karina.
Conduct at least three customer interviews and update the OKR status.
Review and confirm or update the accuracy of the category maturity page charts.
Provide feedback on the release kickoff format and create an issue to discuss alternatives.
Pilot a product discovery sprint for file-by-file navigation.
Review the document on GitLab.com outages and performance issues, and add comments on how to handle proactive performance management.
Review the MR for the product handbook regarding self-organization and dual-track agile.
